messages.author: a36866f7d3584831
messages.subject: P-value for the "samp.ia" (association index).
parts:
Dear all,

I am calculating the Association index for a bunch of SNPs using the samp.ia function (given the fact that I use a genlight object). I am just wondering if a way to calculate a P-value for the distribution and plot it into the samp.ia function. Any help appreciated. 


cheers,


Rick

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] P-value for the "samp.ia" (association index).
parts:
Hi Rick,

There is no way to do this directly in poppr. You might try what Tabima et al. 2018 did and simulate populations with varying percentages of linkage to generate alternative distributions: https://apsjournals.apsnet.org/doi/10.1094/MPMI-10-17-0258-R

Best,
Zhian
